Yes — good call. Images will make this feel more real and trustworthy fast.

## Image Addition Plan (No Code Yet)

### 1) Define image goals per section
- **Hero:** one strong “coffee shop interior” lifestyle image (warm, natural light, people studying/chatting).
- **Problem:** small visual showing “crowded/chaotic cafe” contrast.
- **Solution:** calming image (organized counter, barista handing drink).
- **Features:** 3–4 small supporting images/icons (beans, study table, pickup shelf, kid-friendly snack).
- **Testimonials:** optional customer portraits (or keep text-only if licensing is unclear).
- **Pricing:** subtle background or no image (keep this clean for readability).
- **CTA:** friendly close-up image (coffee + pastry) to support conversion.
- **Footer:** no image (keep lightweight).

### 2) Pick style constraints first (to avoid random look)
- Use a **consistent tone**: warm, neighborhood, candid (not corporate).
- Keep similar color temperature across images.
- Prefer horizontal crops for desktop + safe center composition for mobile.
- Use real people/diverse age range to match students + adults audience.

### 3) Select legal/quality-safe sources
Use only commercially safe stock with clear licenses:
- **Unsplash** (good lifestyle shots)
- **Pexels** (good variety)
- **Pixabay** (backup option)

Rule: store attribution/license notes in a simple local doc for safety (even if attribution not required).

### 4) Build an image shortlist
For each planned slot, shortlist 2–3 options:
- Hero (3 options)
- Problem (2 options)
- Solution (2 options)
- CTA (2 options)
- Feature thumbnails/icons (4 options total)

Then choose one per slot based on:
- clarity at small sizes
- emotional fit
- readability when text overlays it

### 5) Technical implementation plan (static HTML/CSS only)
- Create `assets/images/` and save optimized files locally.
- Use semantic `<img>` tags with meaningful `alt` text.
- Use `<picture>` only where mobile/desktop crops differ.
- Add lazy loading (`loading="lazy"`) for non-hero images.
- Set explicit dimensions to reduce layout shift.
- Compress to WebP/JPG mix for speed.

### 6) Layout integration approach
- **Hero:** full-width or split layout with image + text.
- **Problem/Solution/CTA:** split sections (text + image).
- **Features:** card grid with small thumbnails.
- Keep text contrast high; avoid placing long text on busy photo backgrounds.

### 7) Performance + accessibility checklist
- Target total image weight: ideally under ~800KB for first pass.
- Ensure all alt text is descriptive but concise.
- Decorative images get empty alt (`alt=""`).
- Verify contrast and readability on mobile.

### 8) QA before ship
- Test at common widths: 375, 768, 1024, 1440.
- Check loading speed and visual stability.
- Confirm no license ambiguity for any selected image.
